clips.title: The story
paras: After the Stockade uprising, Warden Thelwater has a troubling discovery about Bazil Thredd. For months before the riot, a man named Maelik visited Thredd with legitimate papers.

Warden Thelwater learned that Bazil Thredd had not been abandoned by his former comrades, as the guards believed. Months before the riot, a quiet visitor began meeting with Thredd once or twice a week. He passed every inspection, carried authorized paperwork, and gave his name as Maelik. Thelwater suspects the visits helped coordinate the bloody uprising. He gathers a physical description and sends you to City Architect Baros Alexston to learn who the visitor was.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: During the first years of Thredd's imprisonment, he never had any visitors. I figured that he was no longer of use to the Brotherhood, so they abandoned him.
Anyway, a few months ago, that all changed; he started to get regular visits... Once, maybe twice a week. It was a strange man--the quiet type. I had my suspicions, but all his papers checked out.
His documents claimed his name was Maelik; here's his description. I don't think he'll be coming to visit Thredd anymore.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Yes, friend? What have you found?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Hmm. Maelik? No, the name doesn't sound familiar and neither does this description. But it could be anybody! A former Stonemason, one of the Defias Brotherhood... Though if he is as well connected as Thelwater suggests, perhaps someone else might recognize him. Let me think.
